body:
Maya: quick question — PR #4822 is green locally but CI failed on the integration matrix: `integration/e2e:gpu-slow` (looks flaky). Is there a way to retrigger only that shard without rebuilding the docker image? Rebuilding takes ~25m.

Ravi: yep, you can ask the CI bot to rerun a single job. We have a bot command you can add as a PR comment. Example: `@ci-bot rerun --job integration/e2e:gpu-slow --skip-image-build` :thumbsup:

Jon: to add detail — the bot will try to reuse existing artifacts. If the artifact TTL expired it falls back to image rebuild. Also you can use the GH UI: open the workflow run -> three dots -> "Re-run failed jobs" and that will keep the image if possible.

Maya: nice. Is there a CLI way? I don't want to click through UI for every rerun.

Priya: you can use `gh` to rerun runs but it's a bit awkward for single jobs. Example snippet to rerun a whole run (you still need to filter to the job):

```
# get the run id for the PR's failing workflow
gh run list --workflow "integration.yml" --branch main --limit 5
# then rerun the run (this reruns the whole workflow)
gh run rerun <run_id>
```

Jon: for targeted job reruns we usually prefer the bot comment. If you want to craft a direct API call you can use Actions API to re-run a workflow run and then trigger only the job by job name — but that's more manual.

Ravi: if you want an example curl for the bot-less approach (advanced):

```
# re-run the workflow run (may rebuild images depending on runner config)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
  https://api.github.com/repos/<org>/<repo>/actions/runs/<run_id>/rerun
```

Maya: how do I find the right job name (matrix child)? The job in GH shows `integration (gpu-slow)` — will the bot accept that exact name?

Priya: use the job id or the exact job name slug. For the bot we use the colon-delimited matrix key: `integration/e2e:gpu-slow`. If in doubt, paste the job name from the UI.

ci-bot: rerun request acknowledged for PR #4822. Queuing job `integration/e2e:gpu-slow` and attempting to reuse existing image artifacts. If artifacts are expired the job will be scheduled with image rebuild.

Maya: queued and looks like it's running now — thanks!

Jon: one small caution — if the test failure touched infra state (DB migrations, caches) a plain rerun can mask the root cause. If it keeps failing, escalate to full rebuild + clean infra repro.

Ravi: also, if you want to preserve caches you can request `--preserve-cache` with the bot: `@ci-bot rerun --job integration/e2e:gpu-slow --skip-image-build --preserve-cache`.

Maya: will do. If it flakes repeatedly I'll open a bisect thread. Thanks everyone.
